mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_outbox (idempotency_key, correlation_id, event_type, event_source_id, channel_type, recipient_user_id, recipient_address, payload_ref_type, payload_ref_id, payload, payload_type) VALUES (#{idempotencyKey}, #{correlationId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{eventType}, #{eventSourceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{channelType}, #{recipientUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{recipientAddress,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payloadRefType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payloadRefId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, CAST(#{payloadJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{payloadType}) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uk_outbox_idempotency DO NOTHING

MERGE INTO notification_outbox t USING (SELECT #{idempotencyKey} AS idempotency_key FROM DUAL) s ON (t.idempotency_key = s.idempotency_key) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (idempotency_key, correlation_id, event_type, event_source_id, channel_type, recipient_user_id, recipient_address, payload_ref_type, payload_ref_id, payload, payload_type) VALUES (s.idempotency_key, #{correlationId}, #{eventType}, #{eventSourceId}, #{channelType}, #{recipientUserId}, #{recipientAddress}, #{payloadRefType}, #{payloadRefId}, #{payloadJson}, #{payloadType})
mapper.select: SELECT t FROM outbox_tenant_ids(ARRAY[#{s}]::text[]) AS t
SELECT FROM notification_outbox WHERE id IN #{i}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, last_error_at = #{errorAt}, claimed_at = NULL, claimed_by = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT channel_type AS "channel_type", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM notification_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY channel_type
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = CASE WHEN status = 'PERMANENT_FAILURE' THEN 0 ELSE attempt_count END, next_attempt_at = #{now}, claimed_at = NULL, claimed_by = NULL, last_error = NULL, last_error_at = NULL, permanent_failure_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PERMANENT_FAILURE', 'PENDING')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification_outbox WHERE status = 'SENT' AND sent_at < #{cutoff}
DELETE FROM notification_outbox WHERE status = 'PERMANENT_FAILURE' AND last_error_at < #{cutoff}
